lines.en: I hardly touch the ground at all.

lines.zh: 脚下的影子比身体清楚。
lines.en: My shadow is clearer than my body.
I walk the receding tide line.
Shallow prints remain in the sand I cross.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在阳光里淡了。
lines.en: My outline pales in the sunlight.
Step by step, ripples follow me.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，手指是透的。
lines.en: I raise a hand; my fingers are see-through.
I slip around to the far side of the reef.
A faint wet trail stays behind.
No hurry; I walk light.
I cross a channel without breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 我的声音比脚步晚一点。
lines.en: My sound arrives a little after my steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁走，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I hug the cliff, almost invisible.
I stop between two stones.
My shadow turns with me.

lines.zh: 我踩着浪的间隙往前走。
lines.en: I walk in the pauses between waves.
I stand and barely take up space.

lines.zh: 水汽在我身上聚了一点。
lines.en: A little mist gathers on me.
The far coastline shimmers.

lines.zh: 水面照着我的脸，很模糊。
lines.en: The water shows my face, blurred.
My reflection is clearer than I am.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到另一只脚。
lines.en: I shift weight to the other foot.
There's a sound in the water.
I don't breathe, and no one notices.
A breeze passes and I waver.
I count the steps on the shore.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过一缕海雾。
lines.en: My fingers pass through a wisp of sea fog.

lines.zh: 我从水里借了一点颜色。
lines.en: I borrow a little colour from the water.
I've stood a long time, unnoticed.
The stones by the water are slick.
You looked twice before you were sure.
I'm at the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候我近了一点。
lines.en: While you blinked, I came closer.
What does my face look like?

lines.zh: 你听到的水声，可能是我。
lines.en: That water sound might be me.
Standing here, you can't quite count me.

lines.zh: 你的影子旁边多了一个。
lines.en: There's one extra shadow beside yours.
Don't stare at the water.

lines.zh: 我说的话，水里也有回声。
lines.en: My words echo in the water too.
Step forward and I withdraw.

lines.zh: 被打中的地方，雾合上了。
lines.en: Where I was struck, the mist closes over.
That made me thinner.

lines.zh: 水从我的伤口里流出来。
lines.en: Water runs out of the wound.
I retreat; my outline blurs.
The pain travels slowly.
I raise a hand to my chest.
Your hand is dry; it feels wrong.
I can't make a sound.
That hit something solid.
I've noted where you stand.
The water on your hands is sweet.
Set the fish down and step back two paces.

lines.zh: 这味道我从水底闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell this from the bottom.
Leave the fish on the stone.
I reach out, but don't touch.
I can't taste texture; a pity.
This isn't enough.
I draw it in like mist.

lines.zh: 你看着，会觉得少了一半。
lines.en: Watch closely; you'll think half of it's gone.
Give me a little more.
You pass through my arm.
I retreat and the ripples spread.
We meet, and it's only a chill.
A damp film stays on you.
I moved aside; you didn't see.
The impact thins my body.
You stepped where I was standing.
It felt like touching water.
I gather myself again.
Don't push; I'll scatter.

lines.zh: 我的同类只在水里完整。
lines.en: My kind are whole only in the water.

lines.zh: 我们两个叠成一个人形。
lines.en: We overlap into one figure.
She stands behind me, unseen.
Together we mimic walking.
The water shows us as one.
When she speaks, it sounds like surf.
We part, then draw together.
She shields me from the light for a moment.
We agree to meet at low tide.
Her face is as blurred as mine.
I reach out and it gets wet.
This scale is thin.
I lift it and it gets lighter.
It blurs in my hand.
I set it in the water.
A cold smell comes off it.
I picked up a stone.
It slipped between my fingers.

lines.zh: 它在我手里化成了海水。
lines.en: It turns to seawater in my hand.
I left a small puddle.
I've found you.
You carry a lot of moisture.
I raise my hand and aim.
This distance suits me.

lines.zh: 水纹一停，我就知道你在了。
lines.en: The ripples stop, and I know you're there.
I slowly solidify.

lines.zh: 这一下从你看不见的角度来。
lines.en: This comes from an angle you can't see.
I skim the water and slowly take shape.
The water sound changed; you didn't notice.
I strike on three.
I follow, always faint.
You look back and see nothing.
I keep to the water's edge.
You stop, and I stop just past the waterline.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你的影子里。
lines.en: My shadow is inside yours.
That reflection on the water is me.
Only a few steps left.
I raise my hand to head height.
You stepped into shallow water; good.
The tide is helping me.

lines.zh: 我一掌打出去，湿冷刺骨。
lines.en: I strike; it's wet and freezing.
A temporary solidity hits it.
A wall of water presses from the side.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，打了个寒战。
lines.en: It steps back and shivers.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，指头穿进它的甲。
lines.en: My fingers pass into its armour.

lines.zh: 这一下的声音像浪拍石。
lines.en: It sounds like a wave on stone.
My body scatters and gathers.
It never saw where I struck from.
I'm behind it.
That was only the first figure.
A layer of mist rises off the water.
I show myself from the mist.
A wet print appears on the sand.
A figure appears by the shore.
My landing makes barely a splash.
The tide happens to pull back a step.
Someone looks this way.
My fingers spread, then close.

lines.zh: 退潮的地方，多了一道湿印。
lines.en: Where the tide withdrew, a wet print remains.
I settle and wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 火把我身上的水汽全蒸干了。
lines.en: Fire boils the mist right off me.

lines.zh: 下坠时我的形状全散了。
lines.en: Falling scatters my shape.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，连影子也淡了。
lines.en: I sink, and even my shadow fades.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的轮廓吹成一片水雾。
lines.en: The blast blows my outline into spray.

lines.zh: 一枚东西穿过我，留下一个洞。
lines.en: Something passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 别人的术法把我定住了。
lines.en: Their spell freezes me in place.
I grow fainter, nearly invisible.
Lightning passes through; I glow all over.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我维持不住。
lines.en: No water here; I can't hold shape.
